title: WPSS/978/2013 of Smt Madhubala Raturi AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
WPMS No. 978 of 2013
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Narendra Bali, Advocate present
for the petitioners.
Mr. Lalit Miglani, Brief Holder
present for the State of Uttarakhand.
The petitioners are Assistant Teachers
in various Government Primary Schools of
the State of Uttarakhand. They are aggrieved
by the impugned transfer order which has
been passed pursuant to the new Transfer
Rules known as "Uttarakhand Teacher
(School Education) First Appointment,
Promotion and Posting on Transfer Rules,
2013" (hereinafter referred to as Transfer
Rules).
The controversy involved in this
matter has been adjudicated by this Court in
Writ Petition No. 750 of 2013 (Mahipal
Singh Rathor and others v. State of
Uttarakhand) and in other connected matters
decided on 30.7.2013, where this Court has
declined to interfere in the transfer of the
teachers done in pursuance of the new
Transfer Rules.
Therefore, the present writ petition is
also disposed of in the same terms and
conditions as made in Writ Petition No. 750
of 2013 (Mahipal Singh Rathor and
others v. State of Uttarakhand).
 No order as to costs.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
29.08.2013
Avneet
